about.title: About CareerRaah.pk
about.subtitle: Our Mission & Methodology
about.missionText: CareerRaah.pk helps Pakistani students and freshers make informed career decisions by providing data-driven guidance that considers their unique circumstances — education, skills, budget, location, and interests.
about.methodologyText: Our algorithm scores each career on a scale of 0-100 using five weighted factors:
about.factor1: Interest Fit (RIASEC): 35% — How well your interests align with the career's profile
about.factor2: Skill Fit: 25% — How your current skills match what's needed
about.factor3: Eligibility: 15% — Whether your education background qualifies you
about.factor4: Budget & Time: 15% — Whether the career fits your available resources
about.factor5: Preferences: 10% — Location, work type, and other preferences
about.dataSourcesText: We gather approximate data from multiple sources and cross-reference them:
sources: Rozee.pk — Pakistan's largest job portal for salary data and job trends
Pakistan Bureau of Statistics — Labour Force Survey data
University websites — Admission requirements and fee structures
Community forums — Reddit, Facebook groups, and professional networks
FPSC, PPSC, NTS — Government job exam data
about.disclaimerText: All data on CareerRaah.pk is approximate and for guidance purposes only. Salary ranges, competition levels, and timelines are estimates based on publicly available information. We strongly recommend verifying any information before making major career or financial decisions. This platform is not a substitute for professional career counseling.
about.updateNote: We aim to update career data every 6 months. Last comprehensive update: September 2025.
